text: The fastest gun in the West had one rule, never draw first.
Imagine you're standing in the street at noon, staring down a guy everyone calls slow-ed.
His hands are at his sides.
He hasn't even looked at his gun, and he just nods at you and says,

text.text: so you grab for your gun faster than you've ever moved in your life, yet you're face
down in the dirt before it clears the holster.
He'd lose a race to the saloon against a guy carrying two beers, but men ride in from
three states away to duel him, and every one of them goes down the exact same way.
The only weird thing anyone ever notices is that Eddie never looks at your face.
He just stares at your hand.
You see, think about the last time your phone slid off a table.
You caught it before you even realized it was falling, because you never decided to catch
But when you went for your gun, you had to decide the exact moment to draw, and that tiny decision
He just waits for your hand to twitch and lets his body react on its own.
